auth_type.correction: api_key (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY recommended; api-key query parameter supported as a fallback)

free_tier_limits.correction: Free plan: 500 requests per month; intended for evaluation, prototyping, and personal or non-commercial projects.

rate_limits.correction: Sustained traffic above 20 requests per 10 seconds is rejected with HTTP 429; monthly quotas also apply by plan.

cors.correction: CORS is supported through per-key origin-hostname allowlisting; browser requests are blocked by default unless the origin is configured.

description.correction: Read-only JSON-over-HTTPS Countries API exposing 90+ normalized fields. The maintained public surface is v5 on api.restcountries.com, and API-key authentication is required.

notes: The official status page reported no current issues, so the service appears operational. However, the directory entry is materially stale: v3.1 is deprecated, the hostname and response schema changed, authentication is now required, and both monthly quotas and throughput limits are published.
